supersedes.hash_algorithm: sha256 over the file bytes as committed; git_blob is the git object id of the same bytes

class_basis: timestamped audit; 'verified_traits' recorded during a run the system ran, but no run id and no declared measurand for the trait entries
note: Appended per the logs mechanism (2026-09-09): logs/ is append-only; the original entry stays readable and unmodified; this correction supersedes it by content hash. An entry whose run cannot be reconstructed is classed UNDETERMINED with fields set unknown rather than skipped.
recorded_by_basis: record field 'system_response' states the system ran the audit and wrote the result
